title: Prediction markets vs. polls: Election forecasting industry faces midterm test
summary:
Prediction markets and pollsters both say Democrats are favored to take both the US House and Senate in the midterms.
That's setting up what could be another chapter in the burgeoning rivalry between prediction markets and polls following 2024's closely watched results.
Three prediction markets place a 77.3% chance of Democrats taking control, while two polling-based models put the chances a bit higher at 80.2%.
This analysis was conducted by averaging the daily odds from three leading prediction markets, Kalshi, Polymarket, and PredictIt, to create one rolling prediction market measure.
This was especially true in 2024, when a 10-percentage-point difference between prediction markets and polls led to some post-election analyses claiming that prediction markets had gotten the results right and polls had gotten them wrong.

title: Stock market today: Dow surges 1,500 points in best day of 2026, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rally after historic midterm election
summary:
US stocks jumped on Wednesday after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in a seismic midterm election, paving the way for a divided government.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI) rose 3%, or over 1,500 points, marking its best single-day performance since President Trump paused a sweeping tariff rollout in April 2025.
Oil prices plunged as the midterm election outcome also raised hopes for an end to the war in the Middle East.
On the economic front, ISM and S&P data showed that US services activity expanded at a slower pace in October as businesses continued to grapple with elevated costs.
AMD ( AMD ) posted a Q3 earnings beat , while McDonald's ( MCD ) grappled with slowing same-store sales growth.

title: The Intel stock collapse is getting worse — and the $3.7 trillion chip rout is spreading
summary:
Chip stocks kept tracking mud back through the house.
The chipmaker slid about 9% after its worst day since 1974 on Oct. 30, when a disappointing forecast knocked nearly 29% off the stock.
Marvell (MRVL) fell even harder, a drop that came as it agreed to buy Lumentum (LITE) in a $115 billion deal.
Intel, Marvell, AMD and the memory names led the chip rout, while Nvidia barely moved.
Chip and memory stocks have lost about $3.7 trillion in market value since Oct. 6, by Yahoo Finance calculations.

title: The dark side of India's $740 million firecracker industry
summary:
The city of Sivakasi in India makes 90% of the country's firecrackers, but every year, dozens of people die in accidental explosions at factories across the region.
We visited workshops producing millions of crackers ahead of holidays like Diwali and New Year's — where workers wear little safety equipment and inhale toxic chemicals to make the beloved firecrackers.

title: Meet the highest-paid White House staffers in 2026 — and see how much they make
summary:
Still, to say that those working at the White House are underpaid would be an overstatement.
On July 1, the White House shared with Congress the salaries of all employees inside the president's executive office, including aides, advisors, and staff leaders, as it is legally required to.
Some of the highest-compensated workers around the president include policy advisors and legal counsel, while others are responsible for the president's communications and personnel management.
The White House did not respond to a request for comment.
